review:
A Trueways western with buffalo, multiplier wilds and a long-term goal. Every scatter fills a badge beside the reels; when it's full, it changes colour and unlocks a shot at the Mega jackpot in Coin Respin.

Coin Respin has three jackpots, and Lightning symbols can expand it. That badge gives the base game a reason to keep watching, which most hold-and-win games lack. High volatility, 5,000x max and 96.7% RTP. Bonus roughly once every 331 spins.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus is rare (about 1 in 331 spins on average)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
